_comment: Example trial GitHub Projects board (UP-795 §3.6). Copy to config/boards/sy.json and fill in real values. The synthetic `SY` prefix distinguishes Symphony tickets from the GitHub issue numbering they wrap — Symphony surfaces them as SY-<issue_number>. Fill in githubProjects.projectNumber after creating the ProjectV2 on the team org; AC2 validation (UP-799) is gated on this. IMPORTANT: githubProjects.states.* values are matched against the ProjectV2 Status field options by EXACT, case-sensitive name. The values below are the GitHub Roadmap-template defaults (note `TODO`, `In progress`, `Human review`). If your project's Status options use different names or casing, edit these values to match the actual options exactly — a mismatch makes fetchTicketsByState silently return empty.
name: SY
